info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Brokered Product Management API
info.description: The Brokered Product Management API facilitates the creation and management of brokered products in the banking sector. This API allows financial institutions to streamline the offering of investment and insurance products to their consumers. Typical use cases include onboarding new brokered products, updating product details, and managing product availability. Developers can utilize this endpoint to enhance service offerings and improve customer engagement through a comprehensive suite of brokered financial solutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new brokered product in the consumer services platform. Provide the necessary details in the request body to register the product successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new brokered product. It must adhere to the specified schema and include all required fields for successful processing.
